svg.title: PWLNet combined workflow map
svg.desc: Process data is trained into a network object, which fans out into three workflows (ReLU-MIP, tanh-PWL, SOSX), each with optional physics-informed training and pruning, that all produce a solver-ready decision model.
svg.text: One trained surrogate, three optimization-aware paths, one solver-ready decision model
train through PWL: no embedding shift
Solver-ready decision model · MILP / MIQP / MISOCP / NLP in Pyomo
